result:
Review complete. Verdict: **approve** (tier1).

The core fix is sound and well-verified: the new PR-URL-resolution guard in `supervisor-entrypoint.sh` is placed correctly (right after `PR_URL` is written, before any `gh pr` call uses it), fails loud instead of letting an empty `PR_URL` fall through to `gh`'s dangerous empty-argument fallback, and I confirmed the real incident it cites (PR #84: `state: MERGED`, `mergedAt: 2026-07-26T10:19:37Z`) actually happened. All new/existing tests pass when run for real against the shipped scripts. No `.github/workflows/**` or auth/db/payment paths touched — tier1 is correct.

I flagged two non-blocking issues in the verdict for the Owner's visibility:
1. The live `/opt/veridian/scripts/supervisor-entrypoint.sh` and `supervisor-sweep.sh` already match this diff byte-for-byte, despite `master` not having these changes and the normal deploy pipeline only syncing from `master` — some out-of-band path pushed these to production before this PR was ever reviewed.
2. The task title claims PR #84 was "registered for real audit," but no adopted task_dir exists yet — only the `adopt` capability was added, not actually run against PR #84.

`review-verdict.json` has been written to the workspace root.
